scope: Local reviewed ToolLease binding with persistent EffectLedger, version-bound approval, native sync/async tools and AI Service dispatch; not remote version authority or credential proxy

fullReactor.skipReason: Optional real-provider test is not enabled

identityCancellation.behavior: Cancelled check rejects and preserves interrupt; subsequent actor use performs new online check; observed inactive status remains irreversible

assertions: Approval contains both reviewed version and host effect intent
Same version and intent replays only after new authorization and approval
Changed version cannot recover or execute prior intent
Revocation in approval and backend precondition prevents business dispatch
Revocation after commit or during recovery prevents raw and checked result disclosure without deleting committed proof
Revocation in before/raw/after callbacks cannot return success
Real AiServices loop uses reviewed effect registration
Compensation uses independent reviewed binding and approval with the exact forward proof; repeated compensation recovers without repeated mutation
Shared actor is not permanently invalidated by local approval-wait interruption; subsequent use rechecks online status and cannot undo actual revocation
remaining: Persistent reviewed release directory and global revocation
Publisher provenance and backend deployment certification
